Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks downhearted after failing the quest.

Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来没什么精神。

Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semble abattu après avoir échoué à la quête.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> sieht niedergeschlagen aus, nachdem sie die Quest nicht geschafft hat.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se ve sin ánimo después de fallar la misión.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece desanimado(a) após falhar na missão.

Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> terlihat murung.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> trông có vẻ buồn bầu sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: क्वेस्ट में असफल होने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> उदास दिख रहा है।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: It's special training when we get back!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 回去之后就开始特训吧！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 回去之後就開始特訓吧！
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ce sera un entraînement spécial à notre retour !
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wenn wir zurück sind, gibt es Spezialtraining!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Quando voltarmos, será um treinamento especial!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: พอกลับไปถึงก็ต้องฝึกพิเศษเลยนะ!
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Khi về, sẽ là đặc huấn!

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: Why don't we try this first?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: その前に、これでもどう？
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Et si on essayait ça d'abord ?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Wie wäre es, wenn wir das hier zuerst versuchen?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ก่อนหน้านั้น ลองนี่ดูก่อนไหม?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Bagaimana kalau kita coba ini dulu?
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Trước đó, cái này thì sao?

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Instead of giving up, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> resolved to keep trying.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、挫けるよりは努力しようとを心に誓った。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>决定与其沮丧，不如继续努力。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>決定與其沮喪，不如繼續努力。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Plutôt que d'abandonner, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a décidé de continuer à essayer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Anstatt aufzugeben, beschloss <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, es weiter zu versuchen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: En lugar de rendirse, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidió seguir intentándolo.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Em vez de desistir, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decidiu continuar tentando.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: แทนที่จะยอมแพ้ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ตั้งใจว่าจะพยายามต่อไป
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Daripada menyerah, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> memutuskan untuk terus berusaha.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Thay vì bỏ cuộc, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quyết tâm tiếp tục cố gắng.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: हार मानने के बजाय, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने कोशिश करते रहने का संकल्प लिया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> still seemed frustrated over her mistake.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ミスしたことがどうにも悔しいようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎对于失误感到非常惋惜。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎對於失誤感到非常惋惜。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> semblait toujours frustré par son erreur.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> schien immer noch frustriert über ihren Fehler zu sein.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ainda parecia desapontado(a) com seu erro.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>ยังคงดูเสียดายกับความผิดพลาดของเธอ
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vẫn có vẻ thất vọng về sai lầm của mình.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> अपनी गलती पर अभी भी निराश लग रही थी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.

Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hellte sich auf, nachdem sie den Trank erhalten hatte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se alegró al recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.

Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hơn sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> खुश हो गया।
